source: src/cards/cards-data.js（唯一卡面事实源；中文卡文优先 textZh）

cards.name: Interrogate
cards.text: Parley. Choose a [[Humanoid]] enemy at your location and test [combat] (3). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is the chosen enemy's damage value. If you succeed, discover 1 clue at your location and 1 clue at any other location.
cards.textZh: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一个[[类人]]敌人并检定[combat](3)。本次检定得到+X难度，其中X为所选敌人的伤害值。如果你检定成功，发现你所在地点的1个线索和其他任意一个地点的1个线索。

cards.name: Delay the Inevitable
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn. Attach to an investigator at your location, under his or her control.
[reaction] When you are dealt damage and/or horror: Discard Delay the Inevitable and cancel all damage and/or horror just dealt.
Forced - When the mythos phase ends: You must either spend 2 resources or discard Delay the Inevitable.
cards.textZh:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。附属到你所在地点的一位调查员，置于该调查员控制之下。
[reaction]在你受到伤害和/或恐惧时：弃掉劫数延后并取消你刚受到的全部伤害和/或恐惧。
强制 - 在神话阶段结束时：你必须花费2资源或弃掉劫数延后。

cards.name: Steadfast
cards.text: While you have 5 or more total remaining health and sanity, Steadfast gains [willpower] [combat] (while you have 10 or more total remaining health and sanity, Steadfast gains [willpower] [willpower] [combat] [combat], instead).
cards.textZh: 你剩余生命值和剩余神志值总和至少为5时，坚定不移获得[willpower][combat](你剩余生命值和剩余神志值总和至少为10时，改为坚定不移获得[willpower][willpower][combat][combat]。

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.text:
You get +1 [combat].
[reaction] When the game begins, if Ace of Swords is in your opening hand: Put it into play.
cards.textZh:
你得到+1[combat]。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果宝剑王牌在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。

cards.name: Fingerprint Kit
cards.text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[action] Exhaust Fingerprint Kit and spend 1 supply: Investigate. You get +1 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, you discover 1 additional clue at your location.
cards.textZh:
使用(3补给)。
[action]横置指纹采集工具并花费1补给：调查。你本次调查得到+1[intellect]。如果你检定成功，发现你所在地点额外1个线索。

cards.name: Connect the Dots
cards.text:
Fast. Play after you discover the last clue at your location.
Discover 2 clues at a location with a lower printed shroud value than your location.
cards.textZh:
快速。你发现所在地点的最后一个线索后打出。
发现一个地点的2个线索，该地点的印刷隐藏值须低于你所在地点。

cards.name: Curiosity
cards.text: While you have 4 or more cards in hand, Curiosity gains [willpower] [intellect] (while you have 7 or more cards in hand, Curiosity gains [willpower] [willpower] [intellect] [intellect], instead).
cards.textZh: 你至少有4张手牌时，好奇心获得[willpower][intellect](你至少有7张手牌时，改为好奇心获得[willpower][willpower][intellect][intellect])。

cards.name: Death • XIII
cards.text:

[reaction] When the game begins, if Death • XIII is in your opening hand: Put it into play.
cards.textZh:
你得到+1[intellect]。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果死神·XIII在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。

cards.name: Well Connected
cards.text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[fast] Exhaust Well Connected: You get +1 skill value for this skill test for every 5 resources you have.
cards.textZh:
每位调查员仅限1张。
[free]横置良好人脉：你每有5资源，你本次技能检定得到技能值+1。

cards.name: Money Talks
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you initiate a skill test.
Instead of the skill type indicated for this test ([willpower], [intellect], [combat], or [agility]), this is a resource skill test. Your base skill value for this test is equal to half the number of resources in your resource pool (rounded down).
cards.textZh:
快速。在你发动技能检定时打出。
本次检定不是其标识的技能类型([willpower]、[intellect]、[combat]或[agility])，而是改为资源技能检定。本次检定你的基础技能值等于你资源池内资源数的一半(向下取整)。

cards.name: Cunning
cards.text: While you have 5 or more resources, Cunning gains [intellect] [agility] (while you have 10 or more resources, Cunning gains [intellect] [intellect] [agility] [agility], instead).
cards.textZh: 你拥有至少5资源时，狡猾获得[intellect][agility](你拥有至少10资源时，改为狡猾获得[intellect][intellect][agility][agility])。

cards.name: The Moon • XVIII
cards.text:
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] When the game begins, if The Moon • XVIII is in your opening hand: Put it into play.
cards.textZh:
你得到+1[agility]。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果月亮·XVIII在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。

cards.name: Deny Existence
cards.text:
Fast. Play when an encounter card or an enemy attack would cause you to do one of the following (choose one): Discard cards from hand, lose resources, lose actions, take damage, or take horror.
You ignore that aspect of the effect. (Each other aspect resolves normally.)
cards.textZh: 快速。在遭遇卡牌或敌人攻击将要导致你执行以下一项(选择一项)时打出：弃掉手牌、失去资源、失去行动、受到伤害、受到恐惧。你忽略该效果的影响。(所有其他效果如常结算。)

cards.name: Eldritch Inspiration
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you would resolve an effect on a [mystic] card that triggers "when," "if," or "after" a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed.
Either cancel that effect, or resolve it an additional time.
cards.textZh:
快速。在你将要结算一张[mystic]卡牌上的效果，且该卡牌有以下触发条件时打出：
在[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号揭示时；
如果揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号；
在[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号揭示后。
取消该效果，或额外结算一次该效果。

cards.name: Prophesy
cards.text: While there are 3 or more doom in play, Prophesy gains [wild] (while there are 6 or more doom in play, Prophesy gains [wild] [wild], instead).
cards.textZh: 场上有至少3个毁灭标记时，预见未来获得[wild](场上有至少6个毁灭标记时，改为预见未来获得[wild][wild])。

cards.name: Track Shoes
cards.text:
Limit 1 [[Footwear]] per investigator.
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] After you move, but before enemies at your new location engage you, exhaust Track Shoes: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, move to a connecting location.
cards.textZh:
每位调查员仅限1张[[鞋子]]。
你得到+1[agility]。
[reaction]在你移动后，新到地点的敌人与你交战之前，横置钉鞋：检定[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，移动到一个连接地点。

cards.name: Act of Desperation
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Act of Desperation, choose and discard an [[Item]] asset that takes up at least 1 hand slot from your hand or play area.
Fight. You get +X [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack, where X is the chosen asset's printed resource cost. If you succeed and that asset was in your play area, gain X resources.
cards.textZh:
作为打出绝望之举的额外费用，从你手牌或游戏区域选择并弃掉一张占用至少1个手部槽位的[[道具]]支援。
攻击。本次攻击你得到+X[combat]并造成+1伤害，其中X为所选支援的印刷资源费用。如果你检定成功且该支援是从你游戏区域弃掉的，获得X资源。

cards.name: Able Bodied
cards.text: While you control 2 or fewer [[Item]] assets, Able Bodied gains [combat] [agility] (while you control 1 or fewer [[Item]] assets, Able Bodied gains [combat] [combat] [agility] [agility], instead).
cards.textZh: 你控制的[[道具]]支援不超过2张时，体格强健获得[combat][agility](你控制的[[道具]]支援不超过1张时，改为体格强健获得[combat][combat][agility][agility])。

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.text:
You get +1 health and +1 sanity.
[reaction] When the game begins, if Five of Pentacles is in your opening hand: Put it into play.
cards.textZh:
你得到+1生命值和+1神智值。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果星币五在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。

cards.name: Ace of Rods
cards.text:
[fast] During your turn, remove Ace of Rods from the game: You may take an additional action this turn, during which you get +2 to each of your skills.
[reaction] When the game begins, if Ace of Rods is in your opening hand: Put it into play.
cards.textZh:
[free]在你回合期间，将权杖王牌从游戏中移除：你本回合可以进行额外1次行动，在该次行动期间你得到每项技能+2。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果权杖王牌在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。

cards.name: The 13th Vision
cards.text:
Revelation - Put The 13th Vision into play in your threat area.
Investigators at your location fail ties during skill tests.
[action] [action]: Discard The 13th Vision.
cards.textZh:
显现 - 将第十三幻象放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
你所在地点的调查员在技能检定期间，技能值等于检定难度时检定失败。
[action][action]：弃掉第十三幻象。
